title: BashaBook
desc: Shared accounts for flats with a hired cook. It tracks meals and payments and shows who owes whom at month end. Installable web app with reminders.

card.lede: Shared accounts for Bangladeshi flats with a hired cook. It tracks every meal and every bazar or bill payment, then shows who owes whom at month end. A website and installable web app in English and Bangla.
points: Meals counted per person per day; tomorrow’s count locks at the cutoff, so the cook knows how many plates
At month end the app checks the cash count matches, then carries each balance forward
Push reminders for the meal lock, payments to confirm and the month-end close
card.alt: BashaBook home page with a month ledger
